_comment: The Nécromancien's retail-style talent trees (format: localTools/oathblade/talentTree.json). One source for its
talent rank spells (localTools/necromancer/Spells.ps1), the server's copy and the talent window's, all built
by localTools/talentTree/buildTalentTree.py. Same grid as the Oathblade's trees: rows alternate between columns
1-3-5 and 0-2-4-6, so every link is one step down and at most one column across.
Effects of dummy ranks live in modules/mod-necromancer, read with GetTalentValue.
